advisory_system_message.description: Custom advisory message template used when on_flagged='inject_system_message'. Must contain a {reason} placeholder. Defaults to a generic advisory message if unset.

api_base.description: Base URL for the Lakera AI API

api_key.description: API key for the Lakera AI service

breakdown.description: Whether to include breakdown in the response

dev_info.description: Whether to include developer information in the response

metadata.description: Additional metadata to include in the request

on_flagged.description: Action to take when content is flagged: 'block' (raise exception), 'monitor' (log only), or 'inject_system_message' (append an advisory system message and let the LLM decide)

payload.description: Whether to include payload in the response

project_id.description: Project ID for the Lakera AI project
